entities.name: Trenzalore
entities.description: Non-canon plane from Doctor Who, a human colony planet where the village of Christmas was located.

entities.name: Christmas
entities.description: Village on Trenzalore containing the last remaining crack in space-time.

entities.name: Siege of Trenzalore
entities.description: Event triggered when the Time Lords broadcast the Question.

entities.name: Eleventh Doctor
entities.description: Died at the end of the Siege in one timeline; his TARDIS became his tomb.

entities.name: Time Lords
entities.description: Broadcast the Question through the crack.

events.summary: In one timeline the Siege of Trenzalore ended with the death of the Eleventh Doctor and his TARDIS becoming his tomb.
events.quote: In one timeline, the Siege ended with the death of the Eleventh Doctor and the transformation of his TARDIS into his tomb.
